title: Cutover & rollback matrix for compliance controls (SOC2/ISO, SSO, audit logs)
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a prescriptive cutover and rollback matrix that maps SOC2/ISO controls to feature rollouts (SSO/SAML, audit-log retention, RBAC changes), assigns evidence owners, defines automated gating criteria, and prescribes rollback thresholds for each milestone. The deliverable will be an operational artifact (JSON + human-runbook) consumed by Release Engineering, Security, and Customer Success during enterprise onboards.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Every compliance-relevant feature has a mapped control and named evidence owner
A2: Cutover steps include pre-checks, smoke tests, and post-cutover verification with clear pass/fail thresholds
A3: Rollback matrix enumerates trigger conditions (error rates, SLO violations, missing evidence) and automated vs manual rollback paths
A4: Runbook links to template GitHub PRs and Confluence audit-evidence playbooks
A5: Stakeholder sign-off from Security, Legal, and two impacted PMs recorded in the ticket

decisions: Decision 1: Audit log retention tiers will be implemented as feature flags per-org to support legacy customers requiring 730-day retention.
Decision 2: SSO/SAML cutover must include a mandatory dry-run on a staging copy of the customer org; no hard cutover without dry-run success.
Decision 3: Rollbacks triggered by >2% token-generation error rate sustained for 10 minutes will initiate automated model fallback and pause new sessions.
Decision 4: Evidence owners are responsible for uploading signed artifacts to the evidence bucket; automated artifact checks will be required for gate clearance.
risks: Risk: KMS/HSM rotations overlapping with cutover window could invalidate evidence encryption keys; mitigation: schedule KMS freeze during cutover or provide key-rotation compatibility tests.
Risk: Latency spikes during SSO assertion backoff may breach customer SLAs; mitigation: canary at 5% plus progressive ramp with monitoring alert thresholds.
Risk: Incomplete audit evidence uploads causing failed gate; mitigation: introduce pre-cutover artifact validator and escrow path for manual upload.
